## Source population, REF and CF

![](source_ref_cf_diagram.png){width=9in}

::: {.notes}
Green source rows form the illustrative REF subset. CF starts as a copy. The CF target, eligibility filters and sampling weights determine which people and trips change.

Person A illustrates a mode switch. C receives an induced trip. D remains unchanged. E illustrates recruitment of an eligible existing source non-user from outside REF. E is not a new resident or a duplicated person. A person can use more than one mode, while an already shifted trip cannot shift again.

The lower arrow represents the wider geographic source as a pool of eligible people and donor trip patterns. Reusing a donor trip pattern may support a fixed trip target without changing fixed user counts. Lower CF targets can reduce active-mode use instead. The next slide explains priorities and fallbacks. The diagram is schematic, not a quantitative example.
:::
